desc: Implement the full solution: parse input, encode LCS DP rows as masks, precompute transitions for all masks and letters, run the M-step DP modulo 998244353, aggregate by popcount, and print ans_0..ans_N.
Verify correctness on the three sample inputs and edge cases such as N=1, repeated characters in S, M=1, and confirm the answers sum to 26^M modulo 998244353.
